Summit Liner Gloves

Merino-blend liners meant to be worn under a shell mitt, thin enough to work a zip, a stove or a phone without taking them off. They are not warm on their own and are not sold as if they were.

The seams sit on the back of the hand rather than the palm, so they do not press into an ice axe. After about forty days of use the fingertips begin to thin — that is normal for a liner at this weight, and we would rather tell you now than have you discover it.

38 USD. One pair.
